verdict.rationale: Datadog documents APM/tracing, Log Management, and metrics dashboards and monitors within one platform, with OpenTelemetry ingestion. Independent users corroborate that its main advantage is correlating APM, custom metrics, and logs through shared tagging and dense cross-linking, and that collecting metrics and traces is easy. One user calls its correlation inferior to Honeycomb, Dynatrace, and Instana, but that is a comparative opinion rather than a concrete failure, so it lowers confidence instead of creating a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party docs that detail trace-to-log-to-metric pivoting and shared-context mechanics (the pack has only page titles), and hands-on evidence of the pivot workflow.
